rootCause: CpfNotificationWorker owns an injected Clock but creates internal UNKNOWN_RESULT values through a factory that reads the wall clock, so provider-null and exception/reconcile outcomes are nondeterministic and cannot carry the actual processing instant controlled by the runtime owner.
actualError: Two exact markUnknown verifications differ only in processedAt nanoseconds because separate Instant.now() calls are used.
requiredFix: Add an explicit-time UNKNOWN_RESULT factory contract, use the Worker processing instant for every Worker-created unknown result, and verify exact deterministic results without weakening argument checks.
prohibited: Do not replace exact verification with any(), truncate timestamps, or remove processedAt from the public result contract.

sourceFix.implementation: Explicit processedAt overload plus injected Worker instant for all Worker-created UNKNOWN_RESULT paths

verification: Complete Notification Dispatch suite PASS 10/10 with zero failures/errors/skips.
